claims.quote: Seventy-five thousand tons—dead-weight—rushing through the fog at the rate of fifty feet a second, had hurled itself at an iceberg.
claims.description: A 75,000-ton passenger liner steaming at about 30 knots (fifty feet per second) runs into an iceberg in fog.

claims.quote: Rowland knew that the holocaust was complete; that the invincible *Titan*, with nearly all of her people, unable to climb vertical floors and ceilings, was beneath the surface of the sea.
claims.description: A giant liner believed unsinkable sinks after striking an iceberg, taking nearly everyone aboard down with it.

claims.quote: Twenty-four boats for three thousand people—lashed down with tarred gripe-lashings—thirty men to clear them away, and not an axe on the boat-deck or a sheath-knife on a man.
claims.description: A giant liner carries far too few lifeboats, 24 for 3,000 people, and lacks the crew and tools to launch them quickly.

claims.quote: They'll run their boats in the other Lane after this, I think—the money-grabbing wretches.
claims.description: After the disaster, shipping lines will move their ships to a different transatlantic lane.
